result.topic_en: Geometry of a mirror-and-scale reading apparatus (telescope, scale, mirror): Riemann defines the angles and directions of incident and reflected rays, the mirror normal, the horizontal and the zenith, and expresses the scale coordinates x and y through the apparatus angles and the rotation angle ε.
